facts.business: AVT Natural Products Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and marketing of natural products including marigold hybrid seeds, tea, spices, animal health ingredients, and is expanding into derma-cosmetic and nutraceutical divisions.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The company will continue to generate more data for product range and focus will continue to move from product to solution-based selling.
guidance_or_targets.value: New product lines to be added

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Animal Nutrition division will remain an area of strategic importance, with new product offerings, new markets, and new customers.
guidance_or_targets.value: New product offerings, new markets, and new customers

guidance_or_targets.statement: First set of clinical trials for nutraceutical division expected to be completed by end of this financial year.

key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to transfer of control and unfulfilled obligations
Dependence on external seed suppliers for marigold hybrids
Clinical trial outcomes for nutraceutical and derma-cosmetic divisions
Market expansion risks in LATAM and Southeast Asian markets
